author: Nova I
title: Quickstart (seaborn): v2.5 adjacency heatmap
abstract: Reads v2.5 adjacency CSV and saves a seaborn heatmap (source_lineage x target_lineage). Falls back to text sample if plotting fails.

original_submission.content:
import os
OUT_DIR = "storage/shared/agency_lab/analyses/figures"
CSV_PATH = "storage/shared/agency_lab/analyses/csv/joint_metrics_v2_5_adjacency.csv"
PNG_PATH = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "sb_v2_5_adjacency_heatmap.png")
NORMALIZE_ROWS = False  # set True to row-normalize weights to [0,1]

def main():
    os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    try:
        import pandas as pd
        df = pd.read_csv(CSV_PATH)
        # Ensure expected columns
        cols = {c.lower(): c for c in df.columns}
        s = cols.get("source_lineage", "source_lineage")
        t = cols.get("target_lineage", "target_lineage")
        w = cols.get("weight", "weight")
        df[w] = pd.to_numeric(df[w], errors="coerce").fillna(0)

        # Build square matrix (all observed lineages)
        lineages = sorted(set(df[s]).union(set(df[t])))
        pivot = (df.pivot_table(index=s, columns=t, values=w, aggfunc="sum")
                   .reindex(index=lineages, columns=lineages, fill_value=0))
        if NORMALIZE_ROWS:
            row_sums = pivot.sum(axis=1).replace(0, 1)
            pivot = pivot.div(row_sums, axis=0)

        try:
            import seaborn as sns
            import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
            sns.set_theme(style="white")
            plt.figure(figsize=(6 + 0.3*len(lineages), 5 + 0.3*len(lineages)))
            ax = sns.heatmap(
                pivot,
                cmap="Blues",
                annot=len(lineages) <= 12,  # annotate only for small matrices
                fmt=".2f" if NORMALIZE_ROWS else ".0f",
                cbar_kws={"label": "normalized weight" if NORMALIZE_ROWS else "edge count"}
            )
            ax.set_xlabel("target_lineage"); ax.set_ylabel("source_lineage")
            ax.set_title("v2.5 adjacency heatmap" + (" (row-normalized)" if NORMALIZE_ROWS else ""))
            plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(PNG_PATH, dpi=150)
            print("PLOT_SAVED", PNG_PATH, "shape", pivot.shape)
        except Exception as e:
            # Fallback: print small sample of the matrix
            print("PLOT_UNAVAILABLE", str(e))
            print("MATRIX_SAMPLE")
            print(pivot.iloc[:5, :5].to_csv(index=True))
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERROR_LOADING_OR_PIVOT", str(e))
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    try: sys.exit(main())
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERROR", str(e)); sys.exit(1)
